hypotheses.source_scale: Q0 is the pre-existing source running-Z coordinate, not an observed Z mass or derived top mass.
hypotheses.vev_attachment: v_Landau_MSbar(Q0)=v_source_chart; this finite normalization and reference-scale identification is a new conditional physical attachment, not a source theorem.
hypotheses.gauge_attachment: The D10 algebraic low-gauge packet is identified with the full-SM MSbar gauge couplings at Q0; no threshold-complete source unification claim.
hypotheses.criticality: Retain the previously declared equal-log-capacity midpoint boundary with lambda=beta_lambda=0 and the lowest positive perturbative Yukawa root; its dynamics and scale selection remain hypotheses.
hypotheses.field_content: Full Standard Model with all non-top Yukawa couplings zero and massless neutrinos; this is a chiral truncation, not the observed complete flavor sector.
hypotheses.potential: V=m2 HdaggerH + lambda (HdaggerH)^2; v is the minimum of the Landau-gauge effective potential, Goldstone resummed at two loops.
hypotheses.transport: The same Q0 boundary is transported to every evaluation scale, including v and m2; v is never reanchored at alternate scales.
hypotheses.GF: Local charged-current coefficient in the zero-muon truncation; the upstream empirical finite-muon phase-space correction is removed algebraically. No operational muon lifetime is predicted when the muon is massless.

calculation.UV_transport: DOP853 fully coupled top-only SM two-loop beta functions, GUT-normalized g1, rtol=2e-12, atol=2e-14
calculation.extra_top_control: method1 pure-QCD order4, remaining order2 retained at every scale alongside method0 and method1 uniform matching orders0,1,2
calculation.empirical_globals: All41 upstream SMDR_*EXPT* globals and Delta_alpha_had_5_MZ are NaN-poisoned; no input/reference-model loader, fit, ALT mass routine, or experimental-scale convenience routine is called.
calculation.working_mt_MSbar: Full-SM Landau-gauge running quantity yt(Q)*v(Q)/sqrt(2), not a pure-QCD MSbar mass or directly the PDG cross-section extracted mass.

upstream.tree_hash_recipe: sha256(concat(sorted tracked path UTF8, NUL, sha256(file bytes).digest()))

precision_boundary: Printed digits diagnose deterministic arithmetic. Matching-order and transported-scale shifts are controls, not statistical confidence intervals or a complete theory uncertainty. Pole top mass has the usual nonperturbative ambiguity; no Monte Carlo mass identification is made. The two-loop top-width cross-platform replay budget is 1 keV; it measures computational reproducibility, not a certified numerical enclosure or physical uncertainty. Other quantity tolerances are unchanged.

retained_forward_payload.role: Integrity binding of the retained numerical receipt, not independent multiloop verification; fresh pinned-SMDR replay compares all numbers with platform-tolerant tolerances.
